section_summary.extract_value: This is a single study examining the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Brazilian adolescents (N=840; 438 boys, M_age=15.50; 402 girls, M_age=15.51). The study found that body appreciation was negatively correlated with body mass index in both genders, and that the BAS-2 demonstrated adequate internal consistency and temporal stability. Significantly higher body appreciation scores were found in boys compared to girls and in underweight/normoweight adolescents compared to overweight/obese adolescents.
